POP_ingress_master:
# POP-only loopback ingress; no BCC/SRS copy before Sieve.
127.0.0.1:10027 inet n - n - - smtpd
  -o syslog_name=postfix/pop-fetch
  -o cleanup_service_name=pop_cleanup
  -o mynetworks=127.0.0.1/32
  -o smtpd_sasl_auth_enable=no
  -o smtpd_tls_security_level=none
  -o smtpd_milters=unix:/run/rspamd/mail-platform-milter.sock
  -o milter_default_action=tempfail
  -o milter_protocol=6
  -o milter_macro_daemon_name=mail_pop_ingress_v1
  -o milter_connect_macros=j,{daemon_name},v,_
  -o smtpd_client_restrictions=permit_mynetworks,reject
  -o smtpd_relay_restrictions=reject_unauth_destination,permit_mynetworks,reject
  -o smtpd_recipient_restrictions=reject_unauth_destination,reject_unlisted_recipient,permit_mynetworks,reject
  -o smtpd_reject_unlisted_recipient=yes
  -o receive_override_options=
  -o content_filter=
pop_cleanup unix n - n - 0 cleanup
  -o recipient_bcc_maps=
  -o sender_bcc_maps=
  -o always_bcc=
  -o sender_canonical_maps=
  -o header_checks=
  -o mime_header_checks=
  -o nested_header_checks=
  -o body_checks=
  -o milter_header_checks=

address_preferences.recipient-syntax.cf: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM virtual_domains d WHERE d.active=1 AND (d.name='%d' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM virtual_domain_aliases da WHERE da.target_domain_id=d.id AND da.alias_domain='%d' AND da.active=1))) THEN CASE WHEN NOT (CHAR_LENGTH('%u') BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND '%u' REGEXP '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._+-]*$' AND LOCATE('..','%u')=0 AND RIGHT('%u',1)<>'.' AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR LOCATE('+','%u')<CHAR_LENGTH('%u')) AND RIGHT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),1)<>'.') THEN '550 5.1.3 Invalid receiving address syntax' WHEN (LOCATE('.',SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1))>0 OR LOCATE('+','%u')>0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT u.email AS address FROM virtual_domains d JOIN virtual_users u ON u.domain_id=d.id LEFT JOIN mail_management.mail_address_preferences p ON p.user_id=u.id WHERE d.active=1 AND u.active=1 AND (d.name='%d' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM virtual_domain_aliases da WHERE da.target_domain_id=d.id AND da.alias_domain='%d' AND da.active=1)) AND (CHAR_LENGTH('%u') BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND '%u' REGEXP '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._+-]*$' AND LOCATE('..','%u')=0 AND RIGHT('%u',1)<>'.' AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR LOCATE('+','%u')<CHAR_LENGTH('%u')) AND RIGHT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),1)<>'.') AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR COALESCE(p.allow_plus,0)=1) AND (u.email=CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'@',d.name) OR (COALESCE(p.ignore_dots,0)=1 AND u.email=CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'.',''),'@',d.name))) UNION SELECT a.source AS address FROM virtual_domains d JOIN virtual_aliases a ON a.domain_id=d.id JOIN virtual_users u ON u.email=a.destination AND u.active=1 JOIN virtual_domains ud ON ud.id=u.domain_id AND ud.active=1 LEFT JOIN mail_management.mail_address_preferences p ON p.user_id=u.id WHERE d.active=1 AND a.active=1 AND (d.name='%d' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM virtual_domain_aliases da WHERE da.target_domain_id=d.id AND da.alias_domain='%d' AND da.active=1)) AND (CHAR_LENGTH('%u') BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND '%u' REGEXP '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._+-]*$' AND LOCATE('..','%u')=0 AND RIGHT('%u',1)<>'.' AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR LOCATE('+','%u')<CHAR_LENGTH('%u')) AND RIGHT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),1)<>'.') AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR COALESCE(p.allow_plus,0)=1) AND (a.source=CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'@',d.name) OR (COALESCE(p.ignore_dots,0)=1 AND a.source=CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'.',''),'@',d.name)))) THEN '550 5.1.1 Receiving address variant is disabled or unavailable' ELSE 'DUNNO' END ELSE 'DUNNO' END
address_preferences.variants.cf: SELECT address FROM (SELECT u.email AS address FROM virtual_domains d JOIN virtual_users u ON u.domain_id=d.id LEFT JOIN mail_management.mail_address_preferences p ON p.user_id=u.id WHERE d.active=1 AND u.active=1 AND (d.name='%d' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM virtual_domain_aliases da WHERE da.target_domain_id=d.id AND da.alias_domain='%d' AND da.active=1)) AND (CHAR_LENGTH('%u') BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND '%u' REGEXP '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._+-]*$' AND LOCATE('..','%u')=0 AND RIGHT('%u',1)<>'.' AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR LOCATE('+','%u')<CHAR_LENGTH('%u')) AND RIGHT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),1)<>'.') AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR COALESCE(p.allow_plus,0)=1) AND (u.email=CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'@',d.name) OR (COALESCE(p.ignore_dots,0)=1 AND u.email=CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'.',''),'@',d.name))) UNION SELECT a.source AS address FROM virtual_domains d JOIN virtual_aliases a ON a.domain_id=d.id JOIN virtual_users u ON u.email=a.destination AND u.active=1 JOIN virtual_domains ud ON ud.id=u.domain_id AND ud.active=1 LEFT JOIN mail_management.mail_address_preferences p ON p.user_id=u.id WHERE d.active=1 AND a.active=1 AND (d.name='%d' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM virtual_domain_aliases da WHERE da.target_domain_id=d.id AND da.alias_domain='%d' AND da.active=1)) AND (CHAR_LENGTH('%u') BETWEEN 1 AND 64 AND '%u' REGEXP '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._+-]*$' AND LOCATE('..','%u')=0 AND RIGHT('%u',1)<>'.' AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR LOCATE('+','%u')<CHAR_LENGTH('%u')) AND RIGHT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),1)<>'.') AND (LOCATE('+','%u')=0 OR COALESCE(p.allow_plus,0)=1) AND (a.source=CONCAT(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'@',d.name) OR (COALESCE(p.ignore_dots,0)=1 AND a.source=CONCAT(REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX('%u','+',1),'.',''),'@',d.name)))) permitted WHERE address<>CONCAT('%u','@','%d')

app_password_query: SELECT ap.password_hash AS password, u.email AS user      FROM app_passwords AS ap      INNER JOIN virtual_users AS u ON u.id = ap.user_id      WHERE 1=1        AND u.id IN (SELECT owner_id FROM mail_management.mail_client_bootstrap_login_owners WHERE BINARY login_name=BINARY LOWER('%{user}') AND active=1)        AND u.active = 1        AND ap.revoked_at IS NULL        AND ap.selector = UNHEX('%{password | if("~", "^misp_[0-9a-f]{32}_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$", password, "misp_00000000000000000000000000000000") | substr(5, 32)}')        AND '%{password | if("~", "^misp_[0-9a-f]{32}_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$", "1", "0")}' = '1'        AND (('%{protocol}' = 'imap' AND '%{local_port}' = '993')          OR ('%{protocol}' = 'pop3' AND '%{local_port}' = '995')          OR '%{protocol}' = 'smtp')

ssl = no
log_path = /dev/stderr
info_log_path = /dev/stderr
base_dir = /var/lib/mail-feature-runtime-v1/compiler/run
state_dir = /var/lib/mail-feature-runtime-v1/compiler/state
mail_driver = maildir
mail_path = /var/lib/mail-feature-runtime-v1/compiler/mail
mail_home = /var/lib/mail-feature-runtime-v1/compiler
mail_temp_dir = /var/lib/mail-feature-runtime-v1/compiler

mail_gid = 5000
first_valid_uid = 1
namespace inbox {
 inbox = yes
 separator = /
 prefix =
}
sieve_extensions = fileinto mailbox copy envelope environment date relational

legacy_auth:
dovecot_config_version = 2.4.1
dovecot_storage_version = 2.4.1
instance_name = mail-legacy-smtp-v1
base_dir = /run/mail-legacy-smtp-v1/instance
state_dir = /var/lib/mail-legacy-smtp-v1
protocols =
listen = 127.0.0.1
ssl = no
default_internal_user = mail-legacy-auth
default_login_user = mail-legacy-auth
default_internal_group = mail-legacy-auth
auth_mechanisms = plain login
auth_allow_cleartext = no
auth_username_format = %{user}
auth_username_chars = abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789._@+-
auth_default_domain =
auth_master_user_separator =
auth_cache_size = 0
auth_failure_delay = 2s
auth_verbose = yes
auth_verbose_passwords = no
log_path = syslog
info_log_path = syslog
syslog_facility = mail
sql_driver = mysql
!include /etc/mail-legacy-smtp-v1/mysql-auth.conf
passdb sql {
  query = SELECT c.password_hash AS password, CONCAT('legacy-smtp-',CAST(c.id AS CHAR)) AS user FROM mail_management.mail_legacy_smtp_credentials c LEFT JOIN mailserver.virtual_users u ON u.id=c.user_id LEFT JOIN mailserver.virtual_domains d ON d.id=u.domain_id WHERE BINARY c.login_id=BINARY '%{user}' AND '%{protocol}'='legacy-smtp' AND c.enabled=1 AND ((c.user_id IS NULL AND c.sender_address IS NOT NULL) OR (c.user_id IS NOT NULL AND c.sender_address IS NULL AND u.active=1 AND d.active=1)) LIMIT 1
}
service auth {
  user = mail-legacy-auth
  unix_listener /var/spool/postfix/private/mail-legacy-smtp-v1/auth {
    mode = 0660
    user = postfix
    group = postfix
  }
}
service auth-worker {
  user = mail-legacy-auth
}
service anvil {
  chroot =
}
legacy_sender_query: SELECT CONCAT('legacy-smtp-',CAST(c.id AS CHAR)) FROM mail_management.mail_legacy_smtp_credentials c LEFT JOIN mailserver.virtual_users u ON u.id=c.user_id LEFT JOIN mailserver.virtual_domains d ON d.id=u.domain_id WHERE ((c.user_id IS NULL AND c.sender_address=LOWER('%s')) OR (c.user_id IS NOT NULL AND u.email='%s')) AND c.enabled=1 AND ((c.user_id IS NULL AND c.sender_address IS NOT NULL) OR (c.user_id IS NOT NULL AND c.sender_address IS NULL AND u.active=1 AND d.active=1))
